prompt:
Create a production sprite sheet of EXACTLY the character in the single reference image. This image is the ONLY visual authority: faithfully animate this existing finished painted sprite, do not redesign him. Sixteen separate full-body drawings in a precisely regular 4-column x4-row grid, each facing the reference's same three-quarter front LEFT direction, same slightly elevated isometric game camera. Character identity must be virtually interchangeable with the reference at game scale.
IDENTITY: lean adult Greek warrior, narrow adult shoulders and slender athletic torso in three-quarter perspective, long mature angular face and straight nose, relatively small golden Greek helmet and compact dark-red crest, plain warm-ivory chest plate, fine dark-warm contours. Copy exact face, helmet/crest, two circular gold clasps, teal shoulder straps, dark petrol-teal pleated skirt with small gold hem, red belt and sash, bare upper arms, restrained forearm guards, slim golden shin greaves, brown open-toed sandals. Ivory breastplate is smooth with understated original contours: NOT a stack of inflated bodybuilder abdominal lobes. Not chibi, not stocky, no enormous head, no broad barrel chest, no round inflated biceps, no thick comic-black outlines. The reference is refined, slender adult painted game art. Match its line weight, proportions, hues, small fine details, soft planar shadows. Copy its oval teal shield with broad ivory inverted-V/Lambda and gold border. Copy its thin vertical spear with ivory leaf tip.
ROWS1-2: Eight frames of a walking cycle while holding the spear upright in the right hand on screen-left, shield in left arm screen-right. Limited controlled walk: pelvis level, tiny natural torso movement, feet pass under the hips, legs alternate truly, no jump/hop. Source frame numbers zero-based left to right:
0 passing step, first leg swings forward with foot just lifted, opposite leg supporting.
1 same first leg forward swing nearing extension.
2 first heel descends close to ground, opposite heel beginning lift.
3 first stride contact, both soles planted at their respective isometric depths.
4 passing step of OPPOSITE leg, first leg supports, second leg swings.
5 opposite leg forward swing with visible bent knee.
6 opposite heel descends close to ground.
7 opposite stride contact, both soles planted at their respective isometric depths.
Feet and shield preserve original sizes; do not inflate shoes. Contacts3 and7 need stable believable ground contact, not elevated toes.
ROWS3-4: Eight bow animation frames. Spear and shield are now strapped to his back at same scale; the shield outer teal Lambda face is visible obliquely. A simple traditional curved wooden Greek bow is in his LEFT hand; his RIGHT hand draws/releases. Aim horizontally toward screen-left in same reference isometric orientation, not a new facing. Feet stay planted in one consistent slightly braced stance for all8:
8 bow low at waist, right hand reaching to nock.
9 raising bow and nocking a single arrow.
10 near-full draw, front arm extends to screen-left, right hand near cheek.
11 full draw with taut string and arrow, strong quiet anticipation.
12 release: arrow has LEFT the sprite and is absent, right fingers OPEN next to cheek, relaxed string still joining bow tips, bow hand stays on grip.
13 followthrough: right hand opens outward slightly, bow stable, no arrow.
14 lowers bow toward waist in recovery.
15 return to bow-low ready, compatible with frame8.
Do not draw projectile streaks or magic. Bowstring always physically connects both tips; no broken strings, no residual arrow after release. Preserve character heights and foot anchor coordinates consistently within each action. Same character scale throughout sixteen cells; the head and torso remain the same man when swapping equipment.
SHEET: 4x4 uniform cells with ample empty margin, no overlap, no borders, no labels, no text. Background absolutely solid bright magenta #FF00FF only, with no checkerboard, shadows, platform, texture or gradient. Full spear/bow tips and all feet must stay inside each cell.
selected_usage: bow_S only; walk0..7 rejected for repeated-leg cycle
runtime_processing: Optional magenta-edge RGB recovery on selected S arc frames only, radius2/excess12/protected red R>=2B; alpha and original source bytes unchanged. See pipeline alignment and manifest source_report.edge_despill.
